title: MalformedLine variant conflates missing-colon and empty-username
description: CredentialStoreError::MalformedLine is returned for both 'line has no colon' and 'username field is empty after trimming'. These are distinct operator errors. A caller who wants to generate different error recovery advice (e.g., 'check file format' vs 'check your username') cannot distinguish them without parsing the Display string, which breaks if the message changes. The fix is a separate variant or a bool/enum field like MalformedLine { label, line_num, reason: MalformedReason }. Low urgency because no current caller matches on the variant — but once any does, adding a field is a breaking API change.
